promises.criteria: Banks settle in XRP at meaningful scale

promises.criteria: Commercial XRP payments product with named customers

evidence.summary: MoneyGram 2021 10-K: ODL cessation December 2020; termination 2021-03-07

promises.rationale: ODL use ceased early December 2020; MoneyGram contract terminated 2021-03-07. Rise and fall stays visible: +1 in 2019, -1 in 2021.

assessment.rationale: XRP 5/20 under the claim-type rule: ledger milestone permanent, payments product ongoing and active, MoneyGram corridor retired (rise and fall stays visible), allowance 3, core open.
assessment.allowance_rationale: Present-tense checklist: working product (XRPL), active team shipping (Ripple), real economic activity tied to the promise (ODL volume). 3 checks; cap is floor(20/5)=4, so allowance 3.
